label.payrollLead: What the tenant's payroll is doing, every run somebody can open, and what those runs are calculated from.
label.nothingReadable: Nothing on this screen could be read.
label.runsAreServerOrdered: The runs are shown in the order Payroll returned them. This screen does not sort them or decide which is current.
label.postureIsNotPermission: Every one of these is an API capability the server decides independently, and this screen offers none of them.
label.nothingPermitted: This run is reversed. It is terminal, and its state permits nothing further.
label.noPeriods: No payroll period has been opened.
label.noGroups: No payroll group has been configured.
label.noExceptions: Nothing was raised against this run.
label.noAdjustments: Nothing has been adjusted on this run.
label.noPayments: No payment instruction has been prepared.
label.noAccounting: No accounting output has been prepared.
label.noDecisionsYet: Nobody has answered this run yet.
label.nothingMoved: No source has moved since this run was calculated.
label.name: Name
label.figuresWithheld: The figures were withheld: reading a payroll run and reading what a named person was paid are separate permissions, and this caller holds only the first.
label.accountingWithheld: The accounting output was withheld: it stands on its own permission, separate from reading the run.
label.paymentsWithheld: The payment instructions were withheld: they stand on their own permission, separate from reading the run.
label.oneResultPerCurrency: One result per employment per currency. Payroll never totals across currencies, and nothing here adds a column.
label.definitionsArePerGroup: Deduction definitions belong to a payroll group. Payroll publishes no tenant-wide read of them, so these are one group's.
label.noteNeedsAdjustPermission: An adjustment's note is published only to a caller who may make one. An absent note is a boundary rather than a missing value.
label.boundaryWrites: Calculating, approving, finalizing, reversing and adjusting are API capabilities the server decides. This screen reads and offers none of them, because a request from this portal carries no authenticated principal.
label.boundaryNames: Payroll holds no name, no bank account and no national identifier. An employment is shown as the identifier Payroll stores, and this screen resolves none of them to a person.
label.boundaryFigures: Reading a run is not reading a salary. A caller who may see that a run covered a thousand people may still not see what any of them was paid.
label.boundaryTotals: Gross, deductions and net are three figures the module calculated and froze. None is derived from the others here, and no column of lines is summed.
label.runNotFound: No payroll run with this identifier was returned.
label.resultNotFound: No payroll result with this identifier was returned.

exception.cost_centre_missing: No cost centre on the assignment
exception.currency_not_permitted: Currency not permitted by this group
exception.eligibility_rule_failed: Eligibility rule could not be evaluated

notice.finalizedRun: This run is finalized. Corrections are made by a reversal or a correction run.
notice.noDocument: Payslip data only. Document rendering and storage are not verified.
notice.noOvertime: Overtime is not verified: Attendance publishes candidate minutes and no approved-overtime contract exists.
notice.noPayment: Payment instructions are prepared only. Nothing here transmits a payment.
notice.noPosting: Accounting output is prepared only. No ledger exists in this product and nothing is posted.
notice.noStatutory: No country pack is configured, so no statutory line is calculated.
notice.staleRun: A source changed after this run was calculated. Recalculate before approving.
notice.unauthenticated: Sign-in is not available in this deployment, so payroll data cannot be shown.
